mapper.insert: INSERT INTO writing_practice_items (user_id, task_type, level, exam_type, topic, prompt_text, source_lang, target_lang, reference_answer, target_labels, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{taskType}, #{level}, #{examType}, #{topic}, #{promptText}, #{sourceLang}, #{targetLang}, #{referenceAnswer}, #{targetLabelsJson}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, task_type, level, exam_type, topic, prompt_text, source_lang, target_lang, reference_answer, target_labels AS target_labels_json, created_at FROM writing_practice_items WHERE id = #{itemId}

SELECT id, user_id, task_type, level, exam_type, topic, prompt_text, source_lang, target_lang, reference_answer, target_labels AS target_labels_json, created_at FROM writing_practice_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO writing_attempts (practice_item_id, user_id, submitted_text, corrected_text, overall_score, criteria, errors, feedback, created_at) VALUES (#{practiceItemId}, #{userId}, #{submittedText}, #{correctedText}, #{overallScore}, #{criteriaJson}, #{errorsJson}, #{feedback}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS attempt_id, a.practice_item_id AS practice_item_id, i.task_type AS task_type, i.level AS level, i.exam_type AS exam_type, i.topic AS topic, a.overall_score AS score, a.created_at AS created_at FROM writing_attempts a JOIN writing_practice_items i ON i.id = a.practice_item_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT a.id AS attempt_id, a.practice_item_id AS practice_item_id, i.task_type AS task_type, i.level AS level, i.exam_type AS exam_type, i.topic AS topic, i.prompt_text AS prompt_text, i.reference_answer AS reference_answer, a.submitted_text AS submitted_text, a.corrected_text AS corrected_text, a.overall_score AS overall_score, a.criteria AS criteria_json, a.errors AS errors_json, a.feedback AS feedback, a.created_at AS created_at FROM writing_attempts a JOIN writing_practice_items i ON i.id = a.practice_item_id WHERE a.id = #{attemptId} AND a.user_id = #{userId}
